title: Law requiring LGBTQI+ health resources and provider map online
summary: This bill would require the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene to publish resources on LGBTQI+ health and gender-affirming care, including information on accessing services and providing culturally competent care, on its website in English and designated citywide languages. It would also require the department to maintain a public, searchable online map of LGBTQI+ health providers showing addresses, hours, contact information, services offered and insurance accepted. The law would take effect immediately.
